metadata.title: Second opinions for medical imaging
metadata.description: Start a secure expert second opinion for MRI, CT, PET/CT and other medical imaging studies.

hero.title: One more expert view on your medical imaging.
hero.description: Securely upload MRI, CT, PET/CT and other imaging studies, then receive an online second opinion from physicians with relevant expertise.

how.title: How It Works
how.text: Reach an expert opinion in four simple steps.

steps.title: 1. Upload Your Images
steps.text: Securely upload MRI, CT, PET/CT and other imaging files.

steps.title: 2. Choose Your Expert
steps.text: Review the right expert for your need or let us guide the selection.

steps.title: 3. Expert Review
steps.text: Your expert physician reviews your images and clinical information.

steps.title: 4. Receive Your Second Opinion
steps.text: View the expert report inside your secure account.

processPage.title: A complex medical imaging process becomes four clear steps for the patient.
processPage.text: Second Opinion shows only the decisions needed to complete the request instead of placing technical language in front of the patient.
processPage.uploadTitle: The system checks before calling the upload complete.
processPage.uploadText: The prototype turns the background ingestion flow into understandable patient states: upload, validation, study detection and readiness for expert review.
processPage.journeyTitle: A visible journey from application to report
processPage.deliveryTitle: The report is delivered in the secure account.
processPage.deliveryText: When the final report is shared with the patient, the experience stays controlled and calm. Secure account access is the baseline instead of email attachments.

why.title: When a health decision matters, another expert view can change the conversation.
why.text: The platform feels simple for patients while case management, image preparation, expert assignment, report versioning and audit logic work behind the scenes.

items.title: Expertise
items.text: Cases are directed to experts with relevant imaging experience.

items.title: Access
items.text: Reach expert perspective beyond geographic limits.

items.title: Clarity

items.title: Progress

experts.title: Our Experts

specialties.title: Specialties

upload.title: A DICOM upload experience that stays simple for patients and controlled for the system.
upload.text: The patient only selects files. In the background, the system checks structure, study details and viewer readiness step by step.

journey.title: Patients follow clear steps instead of technical statuses.
journey.text: Complex clinical and technical processes become a simple journey that highlights the next meaningful action.

report.title: Not free-form text: a structured, readable expert opinion.
report.text: The final report is organized into clinical context, findings, impression, answer to the patient question, recommendations and limitations. This prototype contains no real diagnostic text.

security.title: Your health data is sensitive. We treat it that way.
security.text: Technical and legal wording will be finalized as the real infrastructure matures; this prototype avoids exaggerated certification or guarantee claims.

items.title: Secure connection
items.text: A secure channel is assumed for sensitive data transfer.

items.title: Authorized access
items.text: Case information is matched only to necessary roles.

items.title: Audit records
items.text: Critical actions are designed around audit-friendly behavior.

items.title: Controlled sharing
items.text: Reports are accessed in the account and not distributed as email attachments.

value.title: Not more information. More clarity.
value.text: A second opinion lets you receive another expert perspective based on your existing imaging and clinical information; it does not guarantee an outcome.

faq.question: What is Second Opinion?
faq.answer: It is a focused re-evaluation of your existing medical imaging and clinical information by an experienced expert in the relevant field.

faq.question: Which imaging types can I upload?
faq.answer: You can create a request for MRI, CT, PET/CT, SPECT/CT, X-ray, mammography, angiography and similar imaging files.

faq.question: What is a DICOM file?
faq.answer: DICOM is the standard file format generated by medical imaging devices. The system turns those files into a simpler upload experience for patients.

faq.question: Can I choose my expert?
faq.answer: Yes. You can review physician profiles and choose an expert, or leave the matching to the Second Opinion operations team.

faq.question: How long does review take?
faq.answer: Demo content does not promise a fixed turnaround. In the real service, timing depends on expert availability and case scope.

faq.question: How do I receive my report?
faq.answer: When ready, your report is available in your secure account and can be downloaded as a PDF. It is not sent as an email attachment.

finalCta.title: Complete the requirements for a second opinion step by step.
finalCta.text: Required fields are clearly marked; additional clinical notes and documents can be added later when needed.

items.title: Required: imaging
items.text: Collected during the DICOM or ZIP upload step.

items.title: Required: clinical question
items.text: The specific question the expert is asked to answer.

items.title: Optional: supporting documents
items.text: Reports, discharge notes or lab results can be added.
